label: early first-occurrence j/v input after a 0 or w
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, almost all at steps t=1-4 (80% of mass at t=2-3), never at t=0, the delimiter, or the copy phase. The input is overwhelmingly j or v (82% of mass), occasionally k/h, and nearly always the first occurrence of that token. Strongest when 0 or w came just before (prev_tok 0 lift 13x, w 8x; the top examples look like w 0 [j], q 0 0 [j], w w 0 [v]). Predicating on 0 or w earlier in the prefix gives precision ~0.66 and recall ~0.48 (mass recall 0.66). The misses are mostly weak activations: j/v after other letters such as s, y, l, q, and a few after 0 on other tokens (k, h, e, 3). The 0/w context is graded rather than all-or-nothing. j/v at early positions without a preceding 0/w usually do not fire, and j/v later than t=4 never fire.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=0 (+7.48), prev_tok=w (+5.76), phase=0 & in_tok=j (+4.15), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=j (+4.15), prev2_tok=w (+3.65), prev2_tok=0 (+3.53). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.26), t=6 (-4.60), t=5 (-4.52), t=7 (-4.08).
